Unexpected rain can ruin a nice day out - so you need to make sure you have a packable rain jacket on hand.

That's why we designed the BÆRSkin Heavy-Storm Rain Jacket 2.0 to insulate your clothes like a dry-storage vault. Every zip is sealed. Every stitch is taped with silicone. Engineered with our proprietary BÆR-Tex Water Repellent Coating.
Get the ultimate rain jacket for extreme performance in light or heavy rain - that's still light, packable and flexible enough to wear for any activity.
20,000mm waterproof rating to stay dry when you're commuting, cycling, camping or hiking in sudden rain storms.
Fully adjustable waist, wrists and hood for perfect insulation when the wind gets nasty too - no more leaks in sideways rain!
Our jacket folds into its own stash pocket, making it highly packable without taking up extra space in your backpack.
Features a two-zip system which allows the inner zip of the rain jacket to attach to the new BÆRSkin Hoodie.

The brand new two-zip system of the Heavy-Storm Rain Jacket allows you to attach the BÆRSkin Hoodie to the inner zip of the Heavy-Storm Rain Jacket- while the outer waterproof zip seals the entire garment to create a 3-in-1 Waterproof Outdoor Hoodie that perfect for getting work done outdoors.
This allows your BÆRSkin Hoodie to become a breathable mid-layer that prevents "wet out" while your Heavy-Storm Rain Jacket sends water droplets running!
On top of the water-repellent excellence, this jacket is made with 100% Polyester Ripstop Fabric - prevents tears, rips, and stops your jacket from absorbing dirt & mud.
So, what does RAIN-SULATION mean?

Most outdoor brands use PFAS in their water-repellent coating. PFAS are a group of synthetic chemicals, often called "forever chemicals" because they are highly persistent and don't break down - causing damage to the environment, and serious health concerns for the human body.
The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) states that there is no safe level of PFAS exposure.

Our signature BÆRSkin Rain Jacket Fit is purpose-designed to accommodate activities like Fishing, Golf, Hunting, Camping or Boating. It's like wearing a shield against the rain that you can whip out whenever you need it most!

Please note that our rain jacket is oversized to accommodate layering. To get your ideal size, take chest measurement and match it up with our sizing chart below — and remember, we also have easy exchanges and returns!
Over 9000 5-Star Reviews

Please note that the BÆRSkin Heavy-Storm Rain Jacket 2.0 is intentionally oversized to accommodate a heavy sweatshirt/knitwear item under the rain jacket. So if you wear an XL Hoodie, an XL Rain Jacket will suffice to be worn over the hoodie.

faq.question: What size should I get?
faq.answer: The jacket is intentionally oversized to fit over a heavy sweatshirt or knitwear layer. If you wear an XL hoodie, an XL rain jacket should work over it. If you do not plan to layer, the page advises taking one size down from your usual size.

faq.question: What is a 20,000mm Waterproof Rating?
faq.answer: The rating refers to hydrostatic head: how much water pressure the fabric can withstand before leaking. A 20,000mm rating means the fabric can hold a 20-meter column of water before seep-through. The page positions this as elite-level protection for heavy sustained rain and snow while staying breathable, light, flexible, and packable.

faq.question: What is the BÆRSkin Heavy-Storm Rain Jacket 2.0 made of?
faq.answer: 100% polyester ripstop fabric, positioned for durability and waterproof protection.

faq.question: What is RAIN-SULATION Design?
faq.answer: A waterproof design system combining adjustable waterproof technology with bonded zips and seams. The page emphasizes a waterproof outer shell plus adjustable hood, waist, and wrist cuffs to block rain entry.

faq.question: What does the 2.5-layer feature mean?
faq.answer: A three-part construction: durable outer fabric, waterproof coating applied inside the outer layer, and a sprayed protective half-layer that improves water repellency while keeping the jacket lightweight and flexible.

faq.question: Can I adjust the fit of the BÆRSkin Heavy-Storm Rain Jacket 2.0?
faq.answer: Yes. The jacket has adjustable hood, wrist cuffs, and waist for a customized fit.

faq.question: How many pockets does the BÆRSkin Heavy-Storm Rain Jacket 2.0 have?
faq.answer: Five pockets: two outside waist zip pockets, one shoulder pocket, and two internal pockets.

faq.question: How many velcro patches can I attach to the BÆRSkin Heavy-Storm Rain Jacket 2.0?
faq.answer: One morale patch area above the shoulder pocket. The patch section is 3.15 x 2 inches.

faq.question: How do I care for my BÆRSkin Heavy-Storm Rain Jacket 2.0?
faq.answer: Secure closures before washing, use mild detergent only, avoid fabric softener, wash cold on delicate, air dry, do not dry clean, do not iron, and do not bleach.

faq.question: How do I know my BÆRSkin Heavy-Storm Rain Jacket 2.0 will fit?
faq.answer: The page says the jackets were sized against standard American sizing and points customers to the size guide for ideal fit.

faq.question: Can I return my product?
faq.answer: Yes. The page states a 60-day return window on all orders.

faq.question: When will my order arrive?
faq.answer: United States orders ship from Kentucky and New Jersey warehouses and typically arrive in 2 to 9 business days. Other countries are described as 6 to 14 days from order date; pre-orders ship when back in stock and then follow the relevant delivery window.

faq.answer: The page says purchases between April 21 and June 4 earn entries, with each dollar spent counting as another entry. Winner announcement is stated as June 5, with winner choosing the Jeep Gladiator or $100,000 cash. Open to US and Canada only; no purchase necessary alternative entry is through sharedsweeps.com.
